instruction: Change the default font size in Thunderbird to 14.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled dark mode in Thunderbird by navigating hamburger menu -> Settings -> Add-ons and Themes -> Themes -> clicked Enable on Dark theme. Completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird menus, open Settings, browse Add-ons Manager, interact with UI buttons and checkboxes, scroll through settings pages
metadata.task_rationale: Agent navigated through Settings and saw Fonts & Colors section with font size 16. Changing font size is a related settings task at similar difficulty.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font size from 16 to 14 in Thunderbird Settings > General > Fonts & Colors. Evaluator checks prefs.js for font.size.variable.x-western set to 14.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches prefs.js from the Thunderbird profile directory, which stores all user preferences
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js, ensuring preferences are flushed to disk
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses user_pref() lines and checks font.size.variable.x-western == 14, which is the correct pref key for default font size in Western locale
Expected parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses rule.get('expect', {}) - matching the expected data structure
Single instruction requirement (change font size to 14) is fully covered by the evaluator
